investigation_notes.Description: A high volume (1,120) of file downloads was observed from the restricted SharePoint site https://globalcorp.sharepoint.com/sites/Global_HR_Restricted/, including payroll, executive performance reviews, and bank account exports. The activity occurred at 01:04 local time in Tallinn and represents a large deviation from the user's 24-hour baseline; the user's role (Senior Software Developer in Engineering) does not have an apparent business justification for accessing HR/Finance restricted data. No recent related events or similar alerts were found, and the combination of volume, sensitive content, off-hours timing, and role mismatch supports classification as High Priority for further investigation.
